You must answer on the enclosed answer booklet.
You will need: Answer booklet (enclosed)
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
Follow the instructions on the front cover of the answer booklet. If you need additional answer paper,
ask the invigilator for a continuation booklet.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–18
1 How important was barbed wire as a reason for a prolonged war on the Western Front? Explain
your answer. [40]
How significant were military defeats as a reason for German surrender in 1918? Explain your
answer.
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–45
How important was the War Guilt Clause in undermining early Weimar governments? Explain your
answer.
How significant was gaining the support of the armed forces in Hitler’s consolidation of power
between 1933 and 1934? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–41
How important was the army in maintaining Tsarist rule up to 1914? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant were the weaknesses of the Whites as a reason for the Bolshevik victory in the
Russian Civil War? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY D: THE UNITED STATES, 1919–41
How important was gangsterism as a reason for the repeal of Prohibition? Explain your answer.
How significant was the need to reduce unemployment as an aspect of the First New Deal? Explain
your answer.
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important an aspect of Mao’s reforms was the redistribution of land? Explain your answer.
How significant was the Hundred Flowers Campaign in the removal of opposition in China? Explain
your answer.
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
How important was the denial of political rights to non-white South Africans in the development of
apartheid? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was the control of the media in suppressing opposition to apartheid between 1966
and 1980? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How important was the role played by Britain and France as a reason for Israel’s military successes
between 1956 and 1973? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was Yasser Arafat in the changing relationship between Israelis and Palestinians
during the 1990s? Explain your answer. [40]
